# MyEssayWriter.ai

> > MyEssayWriter.ai is a comprehensive AI-powered academic writing platform offering humanized essay generation, plagiarism detection, content analysis, and professional writing assistance.

MyEssayWriter.ai serves 2.7M+ students worldwide with a suite of 25+ AI writing tools designed to help with essay creation, content optimization, and academic integrity checking. The platform combines automated AI writing capabilities with human writer services and specialized tools for paraphrasing, summarization, citation formatting, and AI content detection.

## Core Writing Tools

- [AI Essay Writer](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/ai-essaywriter): AI essay generator tool that creates essays from topic, level, and source requirements.
- [Content Humanizer](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/content-humanizer): AI humanizer tool to convert AI text into natural, undetectable human-like content.
- [Paraphrasing Tool](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/paraphrasing-tool): Free paraphrasing tool with 9 modes for text rewriting without signup.
- [Summarizer](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/summarizer): AI Summarizer tool for instant text summarization from documents and articles.
- [Grammar Checker](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/grammar-checker): AI grammar checker for correcting grammar, spelling, and punctuation errors.

## Detection & Integrity Tools

- [Plagiarism Checker](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/plagiarism-checker): AI plagiarism checker with detailed originality reports and document analysis.
- [AI Content Detector](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/ai-content-detector): AI content detector for ChatGPT, GPT-4, Gemini, and other AI-generated text.

## Academic Support Services

- [Hire Human Writer](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/hire-human-writer): Professional human writer service for custom academic papers with expert writing help.
- [Citation Generator](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/citation-machine): Citation generator for APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago, and other citation formats.
- [Google Chrome Extension](https://www.myessaywriter.ai/google-chrome-extension): Google Chrome extension with essay writing, paraphrasing, and AI detection.
